verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is first-party marketing saying packages, tools and runtimes can be set up "with just a single command" and that software can be installed, updated and managed, which loosely implies batch package operations. Nothing addresses bulk operations on general items such as files, windows or settings, or scripted or AI-driven batch workflows. Missing for 10: documented bulk or batch operations beyond package installs, scripting or automation surfaces for acting on many items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
